cause_quote: The new Tasks row rendered `const delivery = backgroundTaskDeliveryLabel(task);` from a snapshot whose existing freshness check discarded older-timestamped cancellation corrections.
user_saw: After stopping a child task, the Control UI showed “Cancelled” alongside “Waiting to send to parent” until the operator refreshed the Tasks panel.
summary: The fix gives substantive terminal corrections a strictly newer publication timestamp while preserving execution times and cleanup deadlines.
reasoning: The commit that introduced delivery labels in the chat Tasks panel used the existing merge rule `if (lookupAt < currentAt) { return current; }`, which discards a final cancellation update carrying an earlier timestamp. I checked that the registry already accepted the finalizer’s supplied timestamp and set delivery to `not_applicable` before that UI feature landed, and that the later shared-transition refactor preserved this behavior.
